title: Cinder
text: "Every column in the Ledger starts with a launch time. So does the keel plate on the hull Marrow's team found on Dunmore. Same format, same instant, and the same place of launch. Not Sol."

lines.text: "Cinder. The innermost planet: molten, mostly, and nobody is supposed to be there. One of the relay's carriers goes there too. I've put it on the Gantry's card."

notes: The Foundry opens when two of the three threads are done (STORY.md §16): one event per pair (kindred = dustfall, engram = drop-field, the-proof = the-ledger), each blocked by foundry-route once one has fired, since a group can't hold groups. This pair: Kindred and the Ledger.
